name: Crypto Prices
description: Cryptocurrency prices with 24h change from the free CoinGecko API; coins are found by name or symbol

settingsSchema.description: Settings of the crypto price plugin

coins.description: CoinGecko coin ids to track, in display order; the first entry is shown on the bar tile. Look up ids via https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/list

items.description: One CoinGecko coin id, e.g. "bitcoin" or "solana"

currency.description: Quote currency as a CoinGecko vs_currency code, e.g. "eur", "usd", "chf"; see https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/supported_vs_currencies

alertPercent.description: Price-move alert threshold in percent: a popup notification fires when a coin moved this far (in either direction) since the last alert; 0 disables alerts. There is no shell-side rate limit - this threshold is the frequency control.
